sources: Verified DevPanel platform and DevPanel MCP behaviour; see docs/EVIDENCE.md.

capacityTiers.name: small_2
capacityTiers.note: Used by the tested Drupal CMS deployment.

unlistedTierNote: large_* and xlarge_* are defined by DevPanel and accepted by the MCP upgrade schema, but DevPanel's capacity listing (GET /applications/capacities) does not offer them. Use only after the user confirms their workspace plan allows them.

drupalPhpMinimum.note: Drupal upstream minimum PHP per major version (drupal.org system requirements).

mysql.explanation: DevPanel provisions the database from the workspace's environment (cluster) settings dbEngine/dbEngineVersion. No MCP tool or activation field selects or reports a MySQL version per application.
mysql.resolution: Ask the user to confirm the MySQL version of the workspace's cluster in the DevPanel UI, or choose a workspace on a cluster that provides it. Record the confirmed version in the execution record; never pass it as an MCP argument.

activationDefaults.note: Generic, stack-unaware MCP defaults applied when a field is omitted. capacityLimit is NOT flagged by the plan warning, so always pass it.

testedExample.note: Tested Drupal CMS deployment in the user's DevPanel instance. Example only, not a default.
